purpose: Tune each production model independently with source-WAV-disjoint OOF predictions from the fixed outer-training partition, without using the outer test or its seven noise-condition scores for candidate selection.

execution_size.note: Candidates are summed across models; the three model grids are not multiplied together.

after_search: Review candidates within 2% of each model's best OOF rmse_all together with daily rmse_onb, recall, and false_positive_rate. Then replace every list with one adopted value and run the untouched outer test once.
